text:
Rohan: Quick sync  customer 'Polar' wants a pilot: tenant-level caching (edge prewarm), strict p95 SLA for small requests, and a transparent per-request cost cap. We have 4 weeks. Call out hard blockers vs negotiable tradeoffs.

Keisha: Runtime: edge prewarm + per-tenant cache keys possible. Hard blocker: need a fast cache invalidation API and reserved hot pool. Negotiable: cache TTL (30s vs 2m) depending on cost. Perf tests need 6 business days.

Alberto: Infra: can carve out subnet and reserve GPUs (floor = 3 x A100). Blocker: we need the cache design (memcached vs NVMe) to size correctly. Edge egress IPs for Polar must be whitelisted; booking needs exact SKUs by Wed.

Marta: Security: tenant isolation + audit trails mandatory. Blocker: must have PII redaction rules and an attestation window if HSMs are used. Shadow mode allowed for perf. Also require a short threat-model doc.

Jon: SRE: propose SLOs for pilot: p95 <= 140ms, error_rate < 0.4%. Canary ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days with automated rollback on SLO breach. Need oncall for first 72h. Also ask for synthetic burst script to validate edge prewarm.

Lily: Finance: requested cost cap per 1k tokens from Polar. Reserve infra + edge adds ~$9k/mo. If Polar signs a 3mo commitment we can offer a reduced per-request rate. Product to lead commercial ask.

Keisha: Minimal acceptance checklist proposal:
- cache_arch_decided (memcached vs nvme)
- infra_reserved & egress IPs whitelisted
- perf_p95 <= 140ms at 10% canary
- audit & PII-redaction doc in SOW
- runbook + oncall filled
- cost cap agreed or provisional approval
Owners: product=Rohan, runtime=Keisha, infra=Alberto, security=Marta, sre=Jon, finance=Lily

Rohan: Action items and deadlines:
- Polar to confirm cache TTL & provide 1k prompt sample: due Tue
- Alberto to propose cache SKU (memcached vs nvme) and reserve infra: due Wed EOD
- Marta to publish minimal threat-model & PII mapping: due Thu
- Keisha to schedule perf tests starting Mon and post results here
- Lily to draft 3mo pricing option: due Fri
If any item slips we delay canary 1 week.

Alberto: I'll reserve a temporary hold for 72h while we lock SKUs. Posting SKUs by EOD.

Marta: I'll draft the threat-model and the attestation checklist. Shadow perf ok before attestation.

Jon: I'll prepare the synthetic burst harness and oncall rota. Need two runtime + infra leads for first 48h.

Keisha: Noted. I'll run the perf bench and share logs. If Polar insists on 30s TTL we may need +1 GPU to avoid cache thrashing. Call that out in the SOW.

Rohan: Thanks everyone  I'll draft the SOW asking for a 3mo commitment to enable the 10% initial canary and the cost cap. If Polar refuses commitment, fallback = 5% shadow canary and higher per-request price. Reconvene async in-thread with updates. :memo: :calendar:
